title: Multi-Functional ESP32 Smart Clock & Rust Middleware
description: A distributed IoT desk clock and countdown system pairing a thin ESP32 MQTT client (16×2 I2C LCD, NTC thermistor, dual-axis joystick, piezo speaker) with a Dockerized Rust middleware controller (Axum, Tokio, rumqttc) featuring a pixel-accurate HD44780 Web Dashboard, REST/WebSocket API, AI agent sound triggers, and repeating automation schedules.
Highlights: Centralised Rust middleware (Tokio + Axum + rumqttc) running in Docker alongside Mosquitto and cloudflared with daily rotating disk logs and JSON state persistence
Pixel-accurate 16×2 HD44780 virtual LCD mirror rendered via 5×8 character bitmaps over live WebSockets with contextual screen-mode variables
Thin ESP32 MQTT client with sequence-deduplicated display/audio dispatch, NTC thermistor Steinhart–Hart telemetry, debounced joystick input, and self-healing heartbeat auto-reconnect
Multi-target Doomsday milestone countdowns, configurable countdown timer, daily & custom-interval automation schedules, and OpenClaw / AI agent one-shot piezo sound trigger endpoints
Comprehensive automated test suite covering Rust clock/timer/doomsday/schedule logic, mock MQTT publishing, and REST API routes alongside PlatformIO firmware builds
